title: CIVITA Specification Metadata Schema
description: Defines the metadata object used to identify and version authoritative CIVITA JSON specification files. The schema applies to specification metadata, not to submitted scientific datasets.

id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier of the specification, unchanged across its versions.

description.description: Purpose and scope of the specification.

version.description: Version of this individual specification in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this specification version.

repository.description: Canonical URL of the GitHub repository that maintains the specification.
